-- ==========================================
-- ЧАСТЬ 1: ОСНОВА ИНТЕРФЕЙСА ANTIMATERIALITY
-- ==========================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local parentUI = gethui and gethui() or CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Главный контейнер (Парящая сетка AntiMateriality)
local ClickGUI = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ClickGUI.Name = "AntiMateriality_Core"
ClickGUI.Parent = parentUI
ClickGUI.ResetOnSpawn = false

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 870, 0, 480)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -435, 0.5, -240)
MainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 -- Полностью прозрачный фон для эффекта полета
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = false -- Зафиксировано, двигать нельзя!
MainFrame.Parent = ClickGUI

-- Контейнер для столбиков со спейсингом
local ColumnsContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
ColumnsContainer.Name = "ColumnsContainer"
ColumnsContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -60)
ColumnsContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
ColumnsContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ColumnsContainer.Parent = MainFrame

local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIListLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 15) -- Зазоры между колонками
UIListLayout.Parent = ColumnsContainer

-- Нижний поиск
local SearchBarFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
SearchBarFrame.Name = "SearchBarFrame"
SearchBarFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 35)
SearchBarFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 1, -45)
SearchBarFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 25, 35)
SearchBarFrame.Parent = MainFrame

local SearchCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SearchCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
SearchCorner.Parent = SearchBarFrame

local SearchInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
SearchInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0)
SearchInput.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
SearchInput.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SearchInput.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
SearchInput.Text = ""
SearchInput.PlaceholderText = "Поиск модулей..."
SearchInput.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SearchInput.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 110)
SearchInput.TextSize = 16
SearchInput.Parent = SearchBarFrame

local allButtons = {}
-- ==========================================
-- ЧАСТЬ 2: СБОРКА СТОЛБИКОВ И ИНЖЕКТ ФУНКЦИЙ
-- ==========================================
local function CreateColumn(name, layoutOrder)
    local Column = Instance.new("Frame")
    Column.Name = name .. "Column"
    Column.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 1, 0)
    Column.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 21, 29)
    Column.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    Column.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
    Column.Parent = ColumnsContainer
    
    local ColCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ColCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    ColCorner.Parent = Column
    
    local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
    Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    Title.Text = name
    Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 255) -- Фирменный оттенок AntiMateriality
    Title.TextSize = 16
    Title.Parent = Column
    
    local Scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    Scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -45)
    Scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 40)
    Scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    Scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 2
    Scroll.Parent = Column
    
    local ScrollList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    ScrollList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    ScrollList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    ScrollList.Parent = Scroll
    
    ScrollList:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
        Scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, ScrollList.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10)
    end)
    
    return Scroll
end

-- Инициализируем парящие колонки
local combatList = CreateColumn("Combat", 1)
local movementList = CreateColumn("Movement", 2)
local visualsList = CreateColumn("Visuals", 3)
local playerList = CreateColumn("Player", 4)
local configList = CreateColumn("ConfigManager", 5) -- Правый защищенный столбик

local function AddModule(parentList, text, callback, isConfig)
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 32)
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 29, 41)
    Button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    Button.Text = "  " .. text
    Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
    Button.TextSize = 14
    Button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Button.Parent = parentList
    
    local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    BtnCorner.Parent = Button
    
    local active = false
    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        active = not active
        TweenService:Create(Button, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
            BackgroundColor3 = active and Color3.fromRGB(65, 85, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 29, 41),
            TextColor3 = active and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
        }):Play()
        task.spawn(callback, active)
    end)
    
    if not isConfig then
        table.insert(allButtons, {Instance = Button, Name = text:lower()})
    end
end

-- Модули Infinite Yield
AddModule(combatList, "Kill Aura", function(state) print("AntiMateriality Aura:", state) end)
AddModule(combatList, "Trigger Bot", function(state) print("AntiMateriality Trigger:", state) end)

AddModule(movementList, "Fly (IY)", function(state)
    local h = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if h then h.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, state and 50 or 0, 0) end
end)
AddModule(movementList, "Infinite Jump", function(state)
    if state then
        _G.AntiMatJump = game:GetService("UserInputService").JumpRequest:Connect(function()
            local hum = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then hum:ChangeState("Jumping") end
        end)
    else
        if _G.AntiMatJump then _G.AntiMatJump:Disconnect() end
    end
end)

AddModule(visualsList, "ESP Boxes", function(state) print("AntiMateriality ESP:", state) end)
AddModule(playerList, "Anti-AFK", function(state) print("AntiMateriality AFK:", state) end)

-- Переключатели в ConfigManager
AddModule(configList, "Save AntiMat CFG", function() print("Конфиг AntiMateriality сохранен!") end, true)
AddModule(configList, "Load AntiMat CFG", function() print("Конфиг AntiMateriality загружен!") end, true)
-- ==========================================
-- ЧАСТЬ 3: ПОИСК, ХОТКЕЙ И БРЕНДИНГ СИСТЕМЫ
-- ==========================================

-- Фильтрация по поиску
SearchInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local filter = SearchInput.Text:lower()
    for _, btnData in ipairs(allButtons) do
        if filter == "" then
            btnData.Instance.Visible = true
        else
            btnData.Instance.Visible = string.find(btnData.Name, filter) and true or false
        end
    end
end)

-- Переключение на RIGHT SHIFT
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
    end
end)

-- Сочное брендовое уведомление при старте AntiMateriality
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "AntiMateriality Alpha",
            Text = "Успешно инжектировано! Нажми Right Shift для меню.",
            Duration = 5
        })
    end)
end)

print("=======================================")
print("[SUCCESS]: AntiMateriality Roblox Edition!")
print("[HOTKEY]: RIGHT SHIFT — открыть/скрыть интерфейс")
print("=======================================")
-- =====================================================================
